notes.title: Update 1.43 - Major Rebalance
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!



Update 1.43 brings us a major rebalance of Artillery and Light Vehicles



It should become easier to flank long range units, which would become a little more fragile and less accurate.



To the contrary, some light vehicles became a little more agile to be more useful in flank attacks and chasing off retreating enemies.Read the full balance notes on the WWA Game Hub:

https://hub.wwa.online/news/143-balance-notes


And don't forget to discuss the changes with the other players on our Discord:

https://discord.gg/aR49FMw87c

notes.title: WWA Update 1.35.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders @everyone

1.35.1 update has started rolling out and will become available to everyone shortly!

There are 2 major new things:

- Mastery Jokers

Mastery will no longer get wasted when you reach the limit for a unit, allowing you to apply it to another unit (just like the card jokers)

- Friend list purge

Remember those annoying profiles that can't be deleted from your friends list? Well, they are gone for good!
Your friend list will remove deleted accounts every time you launch the game

notes.title: 1.28 Update + Balance Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

1.28 - one of the biggest and most important updates in the last months - is out!

The main features:


 THE GENERALS ARE BACK!

Head to the game settings and select your preferred General/Officer style!

 WWA very first Season of Iron and Dust

Compete in the Seasonal Leaderboard to get unique rewards that will never be obtainable again!

 A brand new Ranked game mode with no AI players and new MM system

 2 new units and a mystery guest that will come into play a bit later!

 Legendary skins! 

Those orange tickets finally have a purpose! Those don't only have a badass look, but also provide a tiny HP buff!

 USSR (and Puma) units rebalancing

Scroll down to know more!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/3d1974769857b552723ffcd15f3ace1ff6fffae3.png

Puma


 HP increased from 875 to 1100

Puma feels perfect in terms of firepower, but it was too squishy to fully shine and utilize its speed when retreating

T-27 MINI


 Armor penetration increased from 0 to 15
 Explosive armor penetration increased from 0 to 50

Mini was quite good on paper, but struggled in combat when compared to Willys due to no armor pen. We will monitor this one and adjust again if needed.

T-35


 Main cannon armor penetration increased from 160 to 200
 Secondary cannons armor penetration decreased from 200 to 160
 AoE radius increased from 0 to 5

Overall it felt quite silly that the secondary cannons had better armor pen than the main one. We're also adding a small splash to stay on par with the rest of the heavies.

BA-30 SKIER


 Bullet damage increased from 5 to 12
 HP decreased from 1700 to 1500

Skier felt underwhelming compared to HMAG and other similar units. It will not be the best performing armored car, but should feel much better even despite the HP tradeoff.

HT-130 BURNR


 Turret rotation speed increased from 15 to 60
 Armor penetration increased from 20 to 40

Burnr is an anti-infantry unit and it felt weird when it felt weak against armored infantry. This should help it perform within the niche.

KV-2


 Front armor reduced from 200 to 190
 Rear armor reduced from 185 to 175
 Upper armor reduced from 165 to 155
 Armor penetration reduced from 210 to 190
 Turret rotation speed reduced from 50 to 30
 AoE radius reduced from 5 to 3
 Movement acceleration reduced from 2.7 to 1.5

KV-2 is a moving fortress that was sometimes a bit too much to fight against. The new numbers don't make it uplayable, but give opponents a chance.

ISU-152 MKILL


 Horizintal spread increased from 2 to 6
 Vertical spread increased from 1 to 4

Mkill is no sniper, folks, but the firepower remains!

notes.title: 1.25.2 hotfix!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

Ok, 1.25.1 didn't work the way we've expected!

We are reverting some changes and making some tweaks to bring the PC and Android versions back in shape. 
Update 1.25.2 is now available on Steam!

Balance notes:

M18 Hellcat:

 Reload time reduced from 8.5 to 7 sec.
 Horizontal spread reduced from 9 to 8


Hellcat is a glass cannon. When the cannon is slow and not too accurate, we have a problem. This update should help Hellcat to shine again!

M41 Gorilla:

 Shot damage increased from 100 to 200
 Void zone damage increased from 10 to 20
 Void zone duration decreased from 6 to 3 sec.


Gorilla was supposed to rely on the void zone damage, but it turned out that the enemies rarely keep their units in the zone for the full duration. Bumping up both direct and indirect damaged should make M41 an obviously superior choice over Priest (according to its rarity)

T25 "FOGGY"

 HP increased from 1600 to 2200
 Front armor increased from 130 to 150
 Hiring cooldown increased from 130 to 200 sec.


T25 is an overall good medium tank, however we feel like it should stand out a little bit more, being a Legendary unit. This buff does not make FOGGY the strongest unit around, but makes it more sustainable.

M8 Grayhound:

 Main cannon reload time increased from 1.5 to 3 sec.
 HP reduced from 1200 to 900
 Front, back and top armor reduced from 90 to 80


Being an uncommon unit, Hound was overperforming just way too much, often matching or even exceeding light tanks. It would still be a viable choice matching USSR and German armored cars, but would not feel as OP.

M4 Sherman:

 HP reduced from 2500 to 2000
 Front armor reduced from 170 to 130
 Back armor reduced from 140 to 130


As a rare medium tank Sherman outperformed most of the other mediums, making the alternatives quite redundant. This will make it be more in line with the rest of its class.

notes.title: Early Access Bugfixes - 05/03/24
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

We have just released the first major Early Access update to address the biggest issues found after Early Access release, to name a few:

- DLC contents were not properly awarded
(yes, we have DLCs and the first one is free, you should totally check them out on our Steam Store page)
- Players got split into separate matches during the battle
(this mostly affected our PC players, but this should also eliminate certain cases that caused similar issues on a mobile)
- A whole bunch om smaller annoying bugs

We thank you for your support of the Early Access release, for your bug reports an patience!
We are listening to you and hopefully we'd be able to share some more exciting news in the nearest future!
